description: Buildings balancing domain (D-10). Damage/HP values, when they land, use the prototype's x10 combat scale (D-12). Phase 4 placeholder - real balance values land with the Phase 9 port.

_lock.description: Branch+lock protocol state (D-11): the literal string UNLOCKED, or {locked_by, since} while a feature<Domain> branch exists. Set by /start-domain and cleared ONLY by /merge-domain (Phase 8, T-1) - never by the editor.

cost_multiplier.description: Unitless multiplier applied to every building's love cost. Phase 4 placeholder - real balance values land with the Phase 9 port.

sell_refund_fraction.description: Fraction (0..1) of a building's love cost refunded on sell. Phase 4 placeholder - real balance values land with the Phase 9 port.
